Auth.title: Sign in to Stayable Operations
Auth.subtitle: Enter your work email and password.
Auth.error: Invalid email or password, or your account is temporarily locked after too many attempts. Try again later or contact your administrator.

Install.ctaTitle: Install Stayable Operations for faster, full-screen access.
Install.iosBanner: Add Stayable Operations to your Home Screen →
Install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.
Install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen."
Install.iosStep3: Tap "Add," then open Stayable Operations from your Home Screen.
Install.pageSubtitle: Add Stayable Operations to your device for full-screen access and a Home Screen icon.
Install.alreadyInstalled: Already installed? Open Stayable Operations from your Home Screen icon.
